# AudioLDM2 runtime — fully-resolved, hash-pinned lock for
# ~/.portos/venv-audioldm2 on Apple Silicon (arm64 macOS). Do not edit by hand.
#
# scripts/setup-image-video.sh (INSTALL_AUDIOLDM2=1) installs this with
# `pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r`, so every transitive package is
# version- and hash-pinned and a tampered or substituted distribution fails the install.
# The lock is universal across CPython 3.11+ (per-Python versions carry
# environment markers; 3.10 is excluded because filelock's security fix needs 3.11),
# restricted to arm64 macOS wheels.
#
# Regenerate after editing requirements-audioldm2-mlx.txt, from the repo root,
# with a cooldown so brand-new releases are not adopted the day they publish:
#   LOCK="$PWD/scripts/requirements-audioldm2-mlx.lock.txt"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
#   cp scripts/requirements-audioldm2-mlx.txt "$TMP/"
#   printf '[project]\nname = "audioldm2-lock"\nversion = "0"\n[tool.uv]\nenvironments = ["sys_platform == '"'"'darwin'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'arm64'"'"'"]\n' > "$TMP/pyproject.toml"
#   (cd "$TMP" && uv pip compile requirements-audioldm2-mlx.txt --universal --python-version 3.11 \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header --annotation-style line \
#     --exclude-newer <UTC date at least 7 days ago> -o "$LOCK")
# then check the result against OSV (including MAL- malicious-package records).
accelerate==1.15.0 ; platform_machine == 'arm64' and sys_platform == 'darwin' \
    --hash=sha256:5654f8c5eaa0d4fa68b33e287a97765da6849bf6d51dcac874e73fbbddfb6134 \
    --hash=sha256:97eacca0b73e45cb867dbf8c5d5d4dc32219544300e0c8992c7334dc2ef33cec
    # via -r requirements-audioldm2-mlx.txt
annotated-doc==0.0.5 ; platform_machine == 'arm64' and sys_platform == 'darwin' \

    --hash=sha256:c7e58ce09192557605d8bbd92836d7e1d520ac9580096042c0bfd197efacf1bb
    # via typer
